visual.name: advanVisSmartBar
visual.description: Bar and column charts with a variance chart and locally calculated insights that explain your data in plain English. Free: bars, columns, stacked, clustered and 100% stacked, lollipops, automatic direction, axis break for an outlier, Pareto line, Top N with a working Other bar, average, median and fixed lines, highest and lowest highlighting, category images, fx colours, scrolling, drill-down, vector export and a basic headline. Pro (one-month free trial): the full smart headline and findings with How calculated, smart design tips, the IBCS-style variance chart, change against last period, and targets scored met or missed.

dataRoles.description: The name of each bar. Add more fields to drill down.
dataRoles.name: category

dataRoles.description: Optional. Splits each bar into series, stacked or side by side.
dataRoles.name: series

dataRoles.description: The numeric field that drives bar length. Without a Legend, up to six measures become series.
dataRoles.name: measure

dataRoles.description: Optional, Pro. Last year or last month: a grey bar behind each bar, the change, and what drove it.
dataRoles.name: comparison

dataRoles.description: Optional, Pro. A goal, budget or plan per category: a marker on each bar, scored met or missed.
dataRoles.name: target

dataRoles.description: Optional, free. A picture per category, as a data URI (base64 or SVG). Web links cannot be loaded by a certified visual.
dataRoles.name: image

dataRoles.description: Optional. Extra measures to show when hovering a bar.
dataRoles.name: tooltips

dataRoles.description: Optional. A 0/1 measure: the chart is drawn only when it is 1. When it is 0 or blank, a message is shown instead and no values are revealed.
dataRoles.name: showCondition
